english.title: Refuse to give London cab driver an address / give false address
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) having failed or refused to pay a fare lawfully due to a cab driver,

(A)_[refused to give to the driver an address at which you could be found]_
(B)_[gave a false address to the driver with intent to deceive]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 1(c) London Cab Act 1896.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
fail / refuse to pay fare
lawfully due to cab driver
refuse to give to driver an address at which could be found /
give false address to driver with intent to deceive

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.standardstatementoffacts:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) the defendant, having failed or refused to pay a fare lawfully due to a cab driver,

(A)_[refused to give to the driver an address at which he could be found.]_
(B)_[refused to give to the driver an address at which she could be found.]_
(C)_[gave a false address to the driver with intent to deceive.]_

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: 14 days imprisonment and/ or a fine not exceeding level one on the standard scale in addition to the lawful fare

Time limit for prosecutions:
Six months

maxfinetypemagct.description: fine not exceeding level one on the legislative standard scale

libra.complexpenaltydetails: The whole or any part of the fine imposed may be applied in compensation to the driver
